summary: The 8-K, filed by Barclays Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC on behalf of BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2024-5C31, discloses the replacement of the special servicer for the 125 Summer Mortgage Loan, which represents about 3.4% of the asset pool. Greystone Servicing Company LLC was removed and CWCapital Asset Management LLC was appointed as successor special servicer under the BMO 2024-5C7 PSA. The filing is a routine transaction-management notice with no financial terms, consideration, or impact on certificate holders. This is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation.
